summary:
輝瑞最新季度財報優於預期，受惠於核心業務與非新冠產品的穩定成長。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）達 0.77 美元，超越市場預期的 0.68 美元。
• 季度營收達到 150.3 億美元，較去年同期成長 2.6%。
• 非新冠肺炎產品組合持續展現穩健的業務成長動能。
• 成本控制與營運效率提升有助於利潤率改善。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報優於預期展現基本面止穩訊號。對股價短中期而言，有助於修復市場信心，但仍需觀察專利懸崖與新藥商業化進展。追蹤指標包含非新冠產品營收成長率及研發管線進度。

需留意：新冠相關產品需求可能進一步下滑並帶來波動。；未來幾年面臨多項主力藥品的專利懸崖挑戰。；研發管線的臨床試驗結果與審批進度具備不確定性。

summary_en:
Pfizer reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings driven by stable growth in core and non-COVID products.
• Earnings per share (EPS) came in at $0.77, beating the estimated $0.68.
• Quarterly revenue reached $15.03B, representing a 2.60% increase year-over-year.
• Non-COVID product portfolio continues to show steady operational momentum.
• Cost control measures and enhanced operational efficiency supported margin improvements.

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings beat signals fundamental stabilization. For the near to mid-term, this supports investor sentiment, though patent cliffs and new drug commercialization remain key monitors. Track non-COVID product growth and pipeline milestones.

Watch：Demand for COVID-related products may experience further declines and volatility.; Upcoming patent expirations for key drugs pose long-term revenue challenges.; Uncertainty remains surrounding clinical trial results and regulatory approvals for the pipeline.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 實際值 0.77 美元優於預估的 0.68 美元。
